## Goal

Turn immutable source files into a documented, reusable processed dataset.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)

raw_dir <- here("input", "raw")
processed_dir <- here("input", "processed")
output_dir <- here("output")
```

## Inspect

```{r}
df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "population_communes_2024.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

dplyr::glimpse(df)
dim(df)

df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing")

df |> summarise(duplicate_rows = sum(duplicated(pick(everything()))))

df |> count(region, sort = TRUE)
df |> distinct(year) |> arrange(year)
```

## Transform

```{r}
df_clean <- df |>
  mutate(
    municipality_id = as.integer(municipality_id),
    reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
    region = stringr::str_squish(region)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(municipality_id)) |>
  distinct()
```

## Save processed data

```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  df_clean,
  file.path(processed_dir, "population_communes_2024_clean.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```
